brief.headline: Push for a 10–15% price cut and 15-day early payment in return for faster cash — they keep 7.4% profit vs peers' 5.0%, and they're in the grey distress zone so need stable business more than margin

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a 10–15% price reduction on rigid plastic packaging
priceAsk.target: Target the lower end of the typical market band — ₹0.65–0.80/pc at volume, down from today's ₹0.85–0.95/pc range
priceAsk.basis: Market research shows modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume or looser spec. They keep 7.4% profit while similar firms keep 5.0% — that extra 2.4 points of profit leaves room in their price to us

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay 15 days faster (15 days after receipt instead of 30) in exchange for the price cut
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days sooner costs us ₹1.64 L in cash; they borrow money at about 7.02%, so early payment is worth roughly that rate to them — use it to buy down the price

brief.financialLeverage: PGP Glass is rated CARE A+ / Stable and makes ₹3373.51 Cr in sales, so they're big and creditworthy. But their Altman Z-score is 1.45 — the grey distress zone — meaning cash and stability matter to them right now. They also have EPF payment delays and pending legal cases. We're tiny at ₹39.99 L (0.01% of their revenue), so on our own we have little pull. Play the stability card: offer a steady, longer commitment and faster payment to help their cash (their cash is stuck for 78 days vs peers' 71 days), and in return ask for the price cut. Line up Manjushree or Mold-Tek as a credible second source so they know we can walk if the price doesn't move.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score B (65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate already in our system

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader at ₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health score B (73/100) — pails, containers, pharma packaging; strong and profitable alternate for bottles and closures

risks: We're only 0.01% of their business, so alone we have little leverage — bundle more SKUs or commit longer term to matter to them
Grey-zone distress (Altman Z 1.45) and EPF delays mean push gently: frame the ask around stability and faster cash, not a hard squeeze that tips them over
CARE A+ rating means low supply-disruption risk, so they may dig in on price — have Manjushree or Mold-Tek qualified and ready to quote before the meeting
Market backup leads (Reliance, IVL Dhunseri, Ganesha Ecosphere) are unqualified web finds — do not present as approved sources; verify and RFQ only after this meeting if needed
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to lock in a longer commitment with you and pay faster to help your cash flow — in return, we need your price to come down 10–15% to the volume bands we're seeing in the market.
